game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing snow wraiths.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Maze 8 (21×15, 59 junctions): collect 3 crystal(s) from the branches and reach beacon (19, 1). Use a C main program to Program synthesis. Print [10]; final file-scope values must be {}.
controls: Write int main(void) with declarations, assignments, printf and braces. Movement calls moveRight(n), moveLeft(n), moveUp(n), moveDown(n) are game helpers from logicade.h. Run or Step verifies real map goals, printed values and global state in the documented safe C subset.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Test Arena' (Week 6 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Frosted Chapel'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Creating Simple C Programs and Program Structure

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the sleigh from snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel: keep the tests_passed meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: tests_passed drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Function Test Arena – Frosted Chapel Defense
hint: Use printf with stdio.h. File-scope declarations belong before main; block locals hide names only within that block. Coordinates start at the top left.
